highlights: double glazed and gas central heated
summary: Offered to the market with no onward chain, this three bedroom property presents an excellent opportunity for investors or first time buyers looking to put their own stamp on a home. Requiring refurbishment throughout, the property offers fantastic potential to add value and create a modern family home tailored to individual tastes.
description:
ENTRANCE PORCH The porch offers a welcoming introduction to the home and opens into the entrance hallway.

LOUNGE/DINER A spacious lounge diner featuring modern grey laminate flooring and double glazed windows overlooking the front of the property, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the room. Offering ample space for both living and dining furniture.

KITCHEN Located to the rear of the property, the kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units and offers plumbing for a washing machine and room for a freestanding oven.

WC Ground floor toilet with frosted double glazed window.

BEDROOM A good sized double bedroom benefiting from a built in storage cupboard, providing useful space for clothing and household items. The room offers ample space for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture,

BEDROOM A well proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for a double bed and freestanding furniture.

BEDROOM Single bedroom to the rear of the property, ideal for a home office or children's bedroom.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from both front and rear gardens and ample parking spaces close by to the property.
